scope: Uncertainty add-on to the canonical M10 depth-value result. Existing M10 value bars remain unchanged.

candidate_product.depth: Per-pixel physical depth estimate, micrometres, on one declared grid.
candidate_product.uncertainty: Per-pixel one-standard-deviation uncertainty of the candidate depth estimate, micrometres, on exactly the same grid.
candidate_product.validity: An explicit validity mask. Every depth-valid pixel must carry finite, non-negative uncertainty.
candidate_product.exclusion: Candidate uncertainty excludes independent reference-truth uncertainty; the checker combines independent local/repeat terms in quadrature.
candidate_product.systematics: Correlated angle, pitch, perspective, and focus-scale uncertainty stays in the existing value-arm nuisance envelope. It must not be converted into fake independent pixel samples.

nominal_95_interval_coverage.source: Same nominal-95 calibration band already frozen for M9.

predicted_uncertainty_deciles.source: Same decile fraction and variance-ratio band already frozen for M9.

reported_95_half_width_steps.source: The existing M10 median and p95 point-error bars; this prevents all-wide intervals from passing.

evaluation.origin_fit: Subtract one unweighted mean residual before value and uncertainty checks. Reported uncertainty cannot move the fitted origin.
evaluation.unit_adapter: Convert depth residual, candidate sigma, and local/repeat truth sigma from micrometres to focus-step equivalents with the same independently measured conversion before calling the checker.
evaluation.proper_score: Mean Gaussian CRPS in focus-step units, reported for directional commissioning but not thresholded.
evaluation.exact_control: An exact zero-error product reporting zero candidate uncertainty against zero-uncertainty synthetic truth passes the nominal-coverage component as the degenerate exact distribution.

bar_relation: STRICTLY HARDER than the written M10 success clause: all seven existing value bars are retained and five uncertainty vetoes are added.
